decisions.reason: The routing architecture does not change the existing SEO-preservation goal or migration-handling rules, and the source does not state a new SEO decision.
Routing Harbor Valley visitors to its Wix website does not change which legacy content and images must be reused for the new master site.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording that visitors choose a location on the master site and are routed to its Wix website.
The candidate already has a same-message INTRODUCE establishing a separate Wix website for each location connected through the master website.
The candidate already records the same-message separate Wix-account and payment-setup architecture and resumes the requirement after the payout conflict.
The existing same-message MODIFY already places each separate calendar in the location's own Wix website and account.
The source reaffirms the existing master domain but does not change its domain-to-website mapping.
The candidate already has a same-message INTRODUCE establishing one Wix account per location.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY placing each location's bookings on its own Wix website.
The candidate already has a same-message INTRODUCE covering both location-specific payment processing and separate payment setups.
The location-routing architecture does not modify the selected visual reference, layout style, or navigation design requirements.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY placing reporting within each location-specific Wix account and website setup.
